verdict.rationale: API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question for an API-driven card-issuing platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version numbers, versioning schemes, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The cited material covers card creation, authorisation, disputes and webhooks only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
